title: Quick Fix Korean Turkey Banchan
description: A spicy, glassy-jelly Korean banchan made with marinated turkey, perfect for a quick fix after work.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and 1 tablespoon water to make a marinade.
In a large bowl, whisk together the marinade and cornstarch until smooth.
Add the turkey breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade, making sure the turkey is evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey breast to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until the turkey is cooked through.
Transfer the turkey to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a small bowl, mix together the Korean chili flakes, green onions, salt, and black pepper to make a spice mixture.
Add the spice mixture to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the sliced turkey to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the turkey is coated with the spice mixture.
Serve the turkey banchan hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
